locator.text: Display 53.2, p. 53, in the proof of Lemma 5.2

evidence: paper: \int_0^\infty r^2 u_{\theta,n}\,dr = q^{3/2-A+\lambda_n}\int_0^\infty R^2 E_n\,dR,\\ \int_0^\infty r^2 \sum_{i+j=n} u_{z,i}u_{\theta,j}\,dr = q^{3/2-2A+\lambda_n}\int_0^\infty R^2 \sum_{i+j=n} U_iE_j\,dR.

provenance.note: machine audit: worker, gate, reviewer; not confirmed by a human

verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Both displayed lines are instances of one stated Lean identity. `integral_weighted_radial_scale` is the r = √q·R change of variables with an arbitrary power b and an arbitrary radial profile g, over the same range Ioi 0 and with the same r² weight; the 3/2 in the exponent is the r² dr Jacobian, exactly as in the paper. Line 1 is b = -A + λ_n, g = E_n, using u_{θ,n} = q^{-A+λ_n}E_n(r/√q) from (5.1) (the order-0 instance of that substitution is `uTheta_eq_similarity_pullback`, with the general exponent available as the argument of SimilarityProfile.pullback). Line 2 is b = -2A + λ_n, g = Σ_{i+j=n} U_iE_j: each product u_{z,i}u_{θ,j} carries q^{-2A+λ_i+λ_j}, and the power is independent of the split because Lean's order exponent slowOrder h k = 2kh is additive, λ_i + λ_j = λ_{i+j}; pulling the finite sum through the integral then needs only linearity (integrability of each term not checked). No declaration was found that writes the order-n convolution form itself: a search of the index for q-exponents of the shape 3/2 turned up only this file and unrelated R³ analysis, and the slow-profile moment argument is carried out in R coordinates (SlowStressSupport / GlobalStressSupport) rather than by rescaling physical integrals.
